svg.title: Swinging Lexical Network, animated
svg.desc: Target t (yellow) and distractor d (blue) with their effective competitors (green), above the activation over the cohort's neighbours. When activation is spread thinly (high entropy), no word stands out and naming is facilitated; when it pools on a few words (low entropy), those words are the competitors and naming shows interference.
